Asli Stone Kaise Pehchanein?

  • Asli stone haath mein thanda mehsoos hota hai, glass jaldi garam ho jata hai.
  • Natural stone mein halki si andar ki khaami (inclusion) aam hai — bilkul saaf sheesha aksar nakli hota hai.
  • Sultan Gemstone ka har stone us ke certificate ke saath ata hai — certificate par stone ka naam, wazan aur asliyat ki tafseel hoti hai.
  • Wazan hamesha carat aur ratti dono mein confirm karein (1 carat = 1.1 ratti takreeban).

Stone Ki Hifazat

  • Har stone ko alag naram kapre ya pouch mein rakhein — sakht stone naram ko kharash sakta hai.
  • Perfume aur chemical se bachayein, khaas taur par Opal, Feroza aur Moti ko.
  • Halke gungune pani aur naram brush se kabhi kabhi saaf kar lein.
  • Neelam aur Pukhraj jese stones pehenne se pehle apne mahir se mashwara zaroor karein.

Aksar Pooche Jane Wale Sawalat

Kya stones 100% asli hain?

Ji haan, Sultan Gemstone sirf natural stones bechta hai. Kisi bhi piece ki asal photo / video pehle WhatsApp par bhejte hain, aur har stone us ki asliyat ke certificate ke saath diya jata hai.

Qeemat per carat hai ya per piece?

Zyada tar stones per carat bikhte hain, kuch (jaise Feroza, Aqeeq) per piece bhi milte hain. Page par di gayi qeematein ibtedai hain — final qeemat stone ke wazan, rang aur quality par WhatsApp par confirm hogi.

Kya ring mein bana hua stone mil sakta hai?

Ji, chandi ki ring mein setting ki sahulat mojood hai. Apna ring size batayein, design ki photo WhatsApp par bhej di jayegi.

Kya main apne design ki custom ring banwa sakta hun?

Ji bilkul — ye hamari khaas service hai. Apne design ki photo ya screenshot WhatsApp par bhej dein, aur batayein ke us mein konsa stone lagana hai (Zamurd, Neelam, Yaqoot, Feroza, Aqeeq ya apna birthstone). Ring aap ke ring size par chandi mein tayyar hogi. Pehle design, stone aur final qeemat WhatsApp par confirm hogi, phir banai jayegi.

Custom ring ki qeemat kitni hogi aur kitne din mein banti hai?

Qeemat design ki mushkil, chandi ke wazan aur chune hue stone ki qeemat par hoti hai — is liye design dekh kar hi exact qeemat WhatsApp par bata di jati hai, koi chhupa charge nahi. Aam tor par custom ring chand dinon mein tayyar ho jati hai; tayari aur delivery ka waqt order confirm karte waqt clear bata diya jata hai.

Kya chandi ki tasbih aur stone ki tasbih bhi milti hai?

Ji haan — 925 chandi ki naqsh-daar tasbih aur asli stone (Aqeeq, Feroza waghera) ki tasbih dono dastiyab hain, 33 aur 99 danon mein. Upar Tasbih Collection mein photos aur ibtedai qeematein di hain; final qeemat chandi ke wazan aur stone ki quality par WhatsApp par confirm hogi. Gift packing ki sahulat bhi mojood hai.

Catalog wali ring aur custom ring mein kya farq hai?

Catalog wali ring hamara tayyar design hai — photo dekh kar pasand karein, apna ring size batayein aur ring tayyar mil jayegi. Custom ring mein design aap apna bhejte hain (koi bhi photo ya screenshot) aur stone bhi aap ki marzi ka lagta hai — us ki tafseel upar Custom Ring wale hisse mein di hai.

Pakistan ke zyada tar shehron mein 2–4 working days lagte hain. Cash on Delivery mojood hai; 11.11 Sale ke doran delivery FREE hai. Tafseel order confirm karte waqt WhatsApp par bata di jati hai.

Rizq aur karobar ke liye konsa stone best hai?

Riwayati tor par rizq aur kamyabi ke liye Pukhraj (Yellow Sapphire) ka naam sab se pehle liya jata hai, aur karobar aur zehni tezgi ke liye Zamurd (Emerald) ka. Ye riwayati aqaaid hain, kisi nateeje ki guarantee nahi — upar Maqsad wale hisse mein Rizq dabayein, ya WhatsApp par apna burj aur maqsad batayein, photo, wazan aur final qeemat wahin confirm hogi. Pukhraj pehenne se pehle mahir se mashwara zaroor karein.

Aulad ke liye konsa stone best hai?

Riwayati tor par aulad aur ghar ki khushi ke liye Pukhraj (Yellow Sapphire) aur Moti (Pearl) ka naam sab se zyada liya jata hai. Ye aqaaid hain, tibbi mashwara nahi aur kisi nateeje ki guarantee nahi — upar Maqsad wale hisse mein Aulad dabayein, ya WhatsApp par apna burj batayein, photo, wazan aur final qeemat wahin confirm hogi.

Ji haan — Aqeeq aur dusre asli stones par Allah Pak ka naam aur Quran Pak ki ayaat ehtram ke sath naqsh ki jati hain, loose stone aur chandi ki ring dono mein.
